description: The file is a Next.js page component for displaying detailed information about a recipe, including fetching data asynchronously, generating static parameters, and rendering UI components.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Generates static parameters for pre-rendering pages based on all recipes.

methods.name: generateMetadata
methods.description: Fetches recipe data to generate dynamic page metadata (like title, description, and Open Graph info).

methods.name: RecipeDetail
methods.description: Main React component that renders the recipe detail page, fetching data based on route params.
